nodes.name: ChatMessage.css
nodes.summary: Styles individual chat message bubbles for both user and assistant turns, including avatars, markdown-rendered paragraphs and lists, hover action buttons, a blinking streaming cursor, error states, and a collapsible citation list.
nodes.languageNotes: Relies on CSS custom properties (design tokens like --color-primary, --font-body) for consistent theming, and uses a CSS keyframe animation for the streaming text cursor.

nodes.name: ChatThread.css
nodes.summary: Minimal styles for the scrollable chat thread container, defining a thin custom scrollbar for the message list.

nodes.name: Composer.css
nodes.summary: Styles the message composer input bar, including the auto-resizing textarea, send button active/hover states, file upload button with a loading spinner, and attached-file chip tags.

nodes.name: DocumentSelector.css
nodes.summary: Styles the document selector dropdown row used to pick which document a conversation is scoped to, including focus and disabled select states.

nodes.name: Sidebar.css
nodes.summary: Styles the dark-themed application sidebar: logo, new-chat and search actions, scrollable conversation list with active/hover/disabled item states, and a footer with user avatar and logout affordance.

nodes.name: ThinkingIndicator.css
nodes.summary: Styles the animated 'thinking' status row shown while the assistant is generating a response, including a spinning glyph and a shimmering gradient-text sweep, with a reduced-motion fallback for accessibility.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses `background-clip: text` with an animated gradient `background-position` to create a shimmer text effect, paired with a `prefers-reduced-motion` media query override — a solid accessibility pattern for decorative animation.

nodes.name: UpgradeTab.css
nodes.summary: Styles a fixed, vertically-rotated 'upgrade' call-to-action tab anchored to the screen edge.

nodes.name: UploadToast.css
nodes.summary: Styles a fixed-position toast notification that reports document upload success or failure, with a slide-in animation and a dismiss button.
